name: Aisha
source:
Aisha's spirit and soul have been sealed in three layers. If successfully unlocked, her strength will increase significantly. I have a way to deal with it, but she intends to unlock it with her own strength.
Even without unlocking the seal, her talent in this remote small country is top-notch. If her magic circuit were not so terrible, she might get an S rating.
